name: Can outdoor living spaces include home offices?

mainEntity.name: Can outdoor living spaces include home offices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, pool houses or pergola-enclosed offices with AC, WiFi, and soundproofing create productive backyard workspaces while maintaining home separation.
